title: Formal Explanations for Linear Temporal Logic over Finite Traces
abstract: arXiv:2610.35169v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Linear Temporal Logic over Finite Traces (LTLf) is widely used in Artificial Intelligence to specify desired temporal behavior and determine whether finite traces satisfy or violate it. Explaining these outcomes is essential for debugging and trust. However, existing approaches typically capture either sufficient reasons or counterfactual causes, without clarifying their relationship. We introduce a native characterization of abductive (AXps) and contrastive (CXps) explanations directly over finite traces, based on locking and unlocking time-indexed events. We prove its equivalence to the classifier-based formulation, and show that CXps coincide with a recently proposed temporal causality semantics for LTLf. This characterization enables an efficient implementation based on the enumeration of minimal unsatisfiable cores and minimal correction sets of ASP programs. translated_title: 有限轨迹上线性时序逻辑的形式化解释
translated_abstract: 有限轨迹上的线性时序逻辑（LTLf）在人工智能领域被广泛用于描述期望的时序行为，并判断有限轨迹是否满足或违反该行为。对这些判定结果进行解释对于调试和建立信任至关重要。然而，现有方法通常只能捕捉充分理由或反事实原因，而未能阐明两者之间的关系。我们基于锁定与解锁时间索引事件，引入了一种直接作用于有限轨迹的溯因解释（AXps）和对比解释（CXps）的原生刻画。我们证明了该刻画与基于分类器的表述等价，并表明CXps与最近提出的LTLf时序因果语义相吻合。这一刻画使得基于枚举ASP程序的最小不可满足核心和最小修正集的高效实现成为可能。在真实世界事件日志上的实验证明了该方法的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于锁定与解锁时间索引事件、直接作用于有限轨迹的LTLf溯因解释与对比解释的原生刻画，证明了其与基于分类器表述的等价性及与最新时序因果语义的一致性，并通过枚举ASP程序的最小不可满足核心实现了高效计算。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a native characterization of abductive and contrastive explanations for LTLf directly over finite traces, based on locking and unlocking time-indexed events, proves its equivalence to the classifier-based formulation and its coincidence with temporal causality semantics, and enables efficient computation through the enumeration of minimal unsatisfiable cores of ASP programs.
